description_en: Sets the health status of an ECS instance or an Elastic Container Instance (ECI) in a scaling group. In some cases, automatic health checks may not accurately detect the health status of ECS or ECI instances. Manually setting the health status enables quick identification and handling of faulty instances to better meet actual business and O&M requirements
description_zh: 在某些情况下，自动健康检查可能无法准确发现ECS实例或ECI实例的健康状态，通过手动设置实例的健康状态可以对故障实例进行快速识别和处理。此时，您可以调用API SetInstanceHealth设置伸缩组内ECS实例或ECI实例的健康状态，能够更好地应对实际的业务需求和运维情况
kebab_example: aliyun ess set-instance-health --instance-id i-bp1ap6bro51a7fsa0000 --health-status Healthy --api-version 2022-02-22 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetInstanceHealth

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance in the scaling group
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The health status to set for the instance. Valid values:

Healthy: Sets the instance to the healthy state.
Unhealthy: Sets the instance to the unhealthy state
parameters.help_zh:
设置实例的健康状态，取值范围：

Healthy：设置为健康状态。
Unhealthy：设置为不健康状态
parameters.name: health_status
